description: This file defines the 'CreateTestDatabaseCommand' class, a Symfony console command used to create and initialize a test database environment for the OrangeHRM application. It includes logic for dropping and creating databases, restoring data via mysqldump, and generating core fixtures.

classes.name: CreateTestDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class to automate the creation and setup of a test database environment, including dropping existing databases, importing dump data, and generating fixtures.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and input options for database user, password, and dump options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that drops and creates the test database, restores data from dump, and generates fixtures.

methods.name: createTestDBConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a Doctrine DBAL connection to the test database.
